body: **Defect found during sprint 1 acceptance (orchestrator, reported by the DM-248 worker).** Quitting the combined build while a Claude chat process is live logs `Uncaught exception: Error: database is not open` from `SqliteDb.close`. `bootstrap.ts` `runLifecycle` (DM-249) closes `appDb` on every `before-quit`. `quitDisposal`'s `disposeBeforeQuit` cancels the first `before-quit` with `preventDefault`, disposes, and calls `app.quit()` again, so `appDb.close()` runs twice. The app still exits cleanly, no process is left behind, and the restart reopens `app.sqlite` normally. It is not fixed in sprint 1: the fix changes accepted work and needs a test, which would mean another Fireguard run. It is carried into the sprint 2 redraft as a discovery, for the person to decide.
